title: Regional Distribution Lead
description:
Overview

About Pivot Bio: Fueled by an innovative drive and a deep understanding of microbiology, genomics, crop nutrition and agriculture, Pivot Bio is pioneering game-changing advances in fertilizer technology. Our first commercial product harnesses the power of naturally-occurring microbes, modern gene editing and application technologies to provide nitrogen to crops. We are dedicated to providing new solutions for farmers to improve yield as they work to help feed the world’s growing population. Read/Hear more about Pivot Bio on Forbes or PBS News Hour.

We are looking for an experienced professional who can provide regional leadership to propel our seller distribution network success. As the regional distribution manager, you will be responsible to recruit leading talent for both independent sales representative agencies and retail partners. You will also support the onboarding of these top tier sales organizations and develop regional business tactics to improve the performance of high potential middle performers. This individual will be a critical member of the Commercial Sales organization and will work closely with regional sales team leaders and other internal company stakeholders to support the company’s strategic initiatives and aggressive sales growth goals. You must have strong ag industry relationships, leadership, and experience in both business development and Nitrogen management to be effective at building a sustainable, loyal distribution network that is distinguished by our customers as a key competitive differentiator.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and build relationships with a targeted group of high influence prospects (independent sales representative agencies and retail partners) to recruit into Pivot Bio’s distribution network. Local sales team will identify and recruit them and you will lead the official onboarding and training and be the key point of contact at head office location. TSM to work with individual agronomy branches.
  • Partner with the Region Sales Lead (RSL) on distribution partner strategy and overall efforts.
  • Identify additional prospects the local field team will focus recruiting efforts on, collectively supporting the achievement of the new distribution partner’s annual targeted acre goal.
  • Lead and execute a highly coordinated top-notch onboarding process for new sales organizations, establishing strong selling relationships throughout their first year at Pivot Bio (at HQ).
  • Provide leadership around hosting an on-site new distribution partner orientation experience 2-3 times per year at one of Pivot Bio’s training locations.
  • Train new sales organizations how to communicate Pivot Bio’s value proposition, product solutions, and value-selling tools that help position them as a business partner in building Nitrogen management plans.
  • Provide initial overview of Pivot Bio’s sales enablement tools to ensure new sales organizations have the tools to be successful in product positioning conversations with their customers.
  • Coordinate sales calls with new, high influence sales organizations + associate TSM and host grower meetings with their key customers to build trust and product positioning confidence.
  • Drive regional efforts in distribution coverage, gap areas, distribution effectiveness and offboarding recommendations.
  • Work cross-functionally with marketing, communications, finance, IT and commercial operations to communicate field needs and challenges to proactively solve for.
  • Interact closely with Territory Sales Managers, Commercial Agronomists, and Customer Success Center to effectively meet sales goals.

Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to recruit and effectively build relationships with both independent sales representatives and ag retail business partners
  • Strong understanding of ag inputs and Nitrogen management solutions
  • Ability to lead, influence, and drive cross-functional collaboration
  • Excellent communication, presentation and facilitation skills
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills to provide solutions to customer and sales team challenges
  • Excellent time management and ability to prioritize business needs
  • Must be self-motivated and strive for excellence
  • Must be able to work in a nimble, fast paced environment

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This position does not manage anyone

Work Environment

  • Field Based, Remote - the position will require travel 60% of the time within assigned region

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 10+ years in ag sales, business development, training and coaching in a managerial capacity

Must be authorized to work in the United States

Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our CARE - Deep Individual Data team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil .

Join our growing CARE (Coach on Artificial Intelligence for Real Engagement) team at Wellhub and help us build the next generation of AI-powered solutions. This role focuses on organizing and leveraging digital information about users and people to enhance user experience and recommendations. This project involves collecting user data from various sources in multiple formats (photo, video, text, audio). You will be instrumental in processing, analyzing, and utilizing this data to improve the user experience, user recommendations, business insights, and overall platform quality. Such candidates must be avid learners and be prepared to learn quickly. We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running many more cutting-edge projects.

YOUR IMPACT

  • You will develop and maintain data models and structures that enable efficient querying and analysis;
  • You will design, develop, and maintain data pipelines to transform and process large volumes of data from various sources, while adding business context and semantics to the data;
  • You will implement automated data quality checks to guarantee data quality and consistency across the whole data life cycle;
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have created robust and scalable data models from business requirements
  • You have worked collaboratively to collect, prepare and analyze complex business data
  • You can engage engineering and product teams to elicit requirements and present solutions to top management
  • Knowledge of data pipeline tools and technologies (e.g., Airflow, EMR, Kafka).
  • You can collaborate with different teams to understand data needs and develop effective data pipelines
  • You are comfortable understanding big data concepts to ingest, process, and make data available for data scientists, business analysts, and product teams
  • You are comfortable maintaining data consistency across the entire data ecosystem
  • You are motivated to contribute to a data-driven culture and see the impact of your work reflected company-wide

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don\'t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Data Modeling and Data Pipelines is a mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

  • WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Partner Operations Analyst
description:
About 1Password

At 1Password, we're building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Extended Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 165,000 businesses and millions of people trust us to provide seamless, secure access to their most critical information.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Partners are central to our future growth. The Global Partner Team empowers them with the tools, programs, and resources they need to succeed and grow with 1Password.

We're looking for a Partner Operations Manager to streamline internal processes, reporting, policies, and communications that support our partner-facing teams. In this role, you'll improve partner tools, enhance workflows, and drive operational efficiency—internally and externally.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate with teams across partnerships, sales, legal, and marketing. Reporting to a Senior Manager in Revenue Operations, you'll help scale our partner program and contribute to 1Password's continued growth.

You'll join 1Password as a key member of the Revenue Operations team, working cross-functionally with partnerships, sales, legal, and marketing to drive operational excellence in our partner program. You'll report to a Senior Manager within Revenue Operations, under the VP of Revenue Operations.

This is a Remote opportunity within Canada and the United States.

What we're looking for

  • Partner Operations/Revenue Operations - You have a minimum of 3 years experience driving success strategies for a growing partner program, partnership management, or relevant experience within Revenue Operations in the technology industry. You have the experience and confidence to identify areas for strategic improvements, advocate for them internally, implement them, and evolve them.
  • Strong Understanding of Salesforce required - You have experience working with Salesforce and have a strong understanding of its core functionalities around data management, reporting, dashboarding and large scale updates. Salesforce administrator certification is an asset.
  • The Ability to Build and Evolve - The Partner Program is primed with huge growth, but there is so much to still figure out to ensure that our partners are armed for success while scaling our business globally. We need a proactive, independent thinker with high energy and positive attitude. You'll bring a flexible and pragmatic mindset, leverage your resources to solve problems with much ambiguity, and adapt to a fast-paced changing environment.
  • Structured and Organized Approach - You're hyper-organized, and can manage multiple projects and deliverables simultaneously. You're able to manage multiple projects at various stages that require cross functional collaboration and alignment.
  • A Good Human Being - You act with integrity, kindness and respect, always. You're confident enough to challenge the norms and suggest meaningful changes, but humble enough to be part of a strong culture and team that embraces diversity and open discussion.

What you can expect

  • Partner Process—Internal & External - Own the partners sales process internally and externally from end to end. This includes ensuring that current processes are optimized and scalable, and proactively building additional functionalities as the business evolves. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders to create workflows, automations and improvements to drive incremental value.
  • Partner Performance Reporting - You will implement the necessary data structure and reporting to support the tracking and measurements of success for partnerships. You will monitor systems and workflows to ensure data integrity in common metrics such as ARR, partner adoption, engagement, marketing activities, and incentive/spiffs are common measurements of success.
  • Global Partner Success and Health - Behind the scenes, you're ensuring that our partner-facing teams have everything they need to be successful, working alongside several internal teams to ensure that we have the right automations and processes in place, tools, documentation, policies, and communications to recruit, engage and motivate our partner community.
  • We believe in the power of remote work, but we also recognize that some in-person connection with team members and customers is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, occasional travel for in-person engagement will be a part of this role. This may include but is not limited to bi-annual department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events will typically be held in varying locations across Canada and the USA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $87,000USD and $117,000USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $87,000 CAD and $117,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

Our culture

At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You'll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We're looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged at 1Password—it’s an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

Our approach to work

We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we offer

We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
Generous PTO policy
Four company-wide wellness days

Growth and future
Company equity for all full-time employees
Retirement matching program
Free 1Password account

Community
Paid volunteer days
Employee-led inclusion and belonging programs and ERGs
Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at and we'll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

title: Regional Technical Service Manager, Poultry (LATAM & Africa)
description:
Overview

Kemin is a privately held, family-owned company with over 3,300 employees worldwide and manufacturing facilities in Belgium, Brazil, China, India, Italy, Russia, Singapore, South Africa, and the United States. For more than 60 years, Kemin has focused on applying science to improve quality of life, producing over 500 specialty ingredients for humans and animals in the feed, food, health, nutrition, and textile sectors. Kemin serves customers in over 120 countries. The vaccine business is a strategic priority for Kemin. Vaccine innovation is a core part of Kemin’s long-term strategy for growth in animal health.

Regional Technical Service Manager, Poultry (LATAM & Africa)

The Regional Technical Service Manager (TSM) focuses on Latin America & Africa and will operate within the marketing department. The Regional TSM is responsible for the marketing, technical and scientific support of the regional marketing and sales teams regarding our global poultry vaccine platforms. As part of a global team you contribute to strategically drive and support Kemin’s vaccine business across the globe by leveraging and scaling the local Kemin expertise and insights on a global scale.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for leading our poultry vaccine platforms in the LATAM and Africa regions.
  • Drive the strategic marketing and technical support for our poultry vaccine platforms.
  • Analyze market developments and shares in LATAM and Africa and provide a strategy to maintain or reach the Top 10 players for the key market segments in which we participate.
  • Develop robust regional technical and marketing plans.
  • Design and implement the “Go to Market” strategy at a regional level for LATAM and Africa.
  • Oversee Brand life cycles from a strategic planning perspective and work on “Renovation” or “Innovation” to extend the product life cycle, including the planning of field studies to support these efforts within the regions and product launching activities.
  • Actively work on publications and publication strategies relevant to the regions.
  • Involve key thought and market leaders from LATAM and Africa to support the positioning of our platforms and transfer these insights to our teams.
  • Translate relevant regional field issues and customer challenges in poultry health into solutions to support our local sales, technical, and marketing teams and ultimately our customers.
  • Participate in and attend local and regional exhibitions, seminars, trainings, and workshops within LATAM and Africa.
  • Support R&D and Regulatory Affairs teams where needed, by collecting technical information and trial results from the regions.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Veterinary Medicine, ideally with a specialization in poultry health.
  • Field experience managing the health status of poultry, preferably with experience in the LATAM and/or Africa markets.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with an understanding of customer needs in diverse cultural contexts.
  • Excellent writing skills (English) and the ability to provide adequate synthesis.
  • A high degree of personal motivation, a desire to make an immediate contribution, and a sense of urgency.
  • Experience working effectively in a cross-functional team.
  • Fluent in English. Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, or French is highly desirable to effectively cover the LATAM and Africa regions.
  • A track record in regional technical or marketing management.
  • Experience in a technical/commercial business in animal health with a focus on poultry.

Working Conditions

  • You will be home office based or based at one of our regional headquarters and will travel across the globe (50% of your time annually).

What Is In It For You

  • Join a highly motivated and truly global team that is rapidly expanding its footprint in the vaccine industry.
  • Continued learning opportunities - Kemin recently launched a corporate university with online and in-person training opportunities for growth and development throughout your entire career.
  • The chance to give back to our world - Through our foundation of servant leadership, we are proud to offer ample service opportunities. Kemin has a valued corporate partnership with both The World Food Program and Habitat for Humanity, in addition to many local initiatives.
  • A competitive financial package - in addition to your salary, we offer an uncapped bonus opportunity and fringe additional benefits.

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Engineering and Information Technology

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Overview

gener8tor's turnkey platform for the creative economy connects startups, entrepreneurs, artists, investors, universities and corporations. The gener8tor platform includes pre-accelerators, accelerators, corporate programming, conferences and fellowships focused on entrepreneurs, artists, musicians, startups and job seekers.

Location: Remote, Latin America based

Salary: $2,000–$3,000/month

gener8tor is seeking a Social Media Manager who will publish to gener8tor-owned channels while tracking, analyzing, and collaborating across the broader ecosystem—including startups, program partners, investors, and other stakeholders. This person will build and maintain a central social database (accounts, handles, mentions, tags, engagement metrics) across all relevant platforms, and translate insights into content, partnerships, and amplification that elevate our programming and deliver value for our partner accounts. The Social Media Manager will collaborate with Marketing, Partnerships, and program leads to turn social listening into action: smarter stories, better timing, stronger distribution, and measurable impact. This person will report to the VP of Business Development and work closely with the broader Marketing team. They will also collaborate with product line leaders to support our programs, including gBETA Pre-Accelerators, gener8tor Investment Accelerators and Skills Accelerators.

Note: Our values are core to how we work. If they don't resonate with you, this role might not be the right fit.

Responsibilities

  • Own gener8tor social publishing: plan, write, and schedule content only for gener8tor-owned channels (e.g., LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, TikTok as applicable); ensure brand voice, accessibility, and consistency.
  • Build and maintain a master social database covering startups, program partners, investors, alumni, and stakeholders (handles, platforms, tags, relationship type, vertical, geography, posting cadence, engagement history).
  • Monitor and log ecosystem mentions of gener8tor programs and partners; tag and categorize mentions; surface opportunities for amplification, cross-posting, and timely outreach.
  • Track engagement and performance across platforms with dashboards and reports (impressions, ER, clicks, follower growth, traffic, conversions, sentiment); share insights with Marketing, Partnerships, and program leads.
  • Create amplification toolkits (copy blocks, assets, links, hashtags, UTMs) for startups and partners to promote program milestones (cohort launches, demo days, challenges, announcements).
  • Collaborate with startups and partners to coordinate timing, message pull-through, and co-marketing moments; maintain simple SLAs for requests and approvals.
  • Maintain a content calendar aligned to program timelines; coordinate with PR, email, web, and events to maximize reach and sequencing.
  • Stand up and continuously improve social listening and governance (keywords, hashtags, competitor/peer sets, handle hygiene, escalation paths for issues).
  • Own community management on gener8tor channels: respond/route DMs and comments, escalate partner questions, and capture FAQs for future content.
  • Manage an organized asset library (images, video clips, templates); brief Design on needs; ensure rights/credits and brand compliance.
  • Measure what matters: tie social activity to program KPIs (applications, attendance, speaker/investor interest, partner satisfaction) and recommend next actions.
  • Support event coverage (live posting and recaps) for OnRamp and other flagship moments, coordinating with PR and on-site teams.
  • Handle multiple projects and a high volume of asks while meeting SLAs and deadlines; document processes to ensure reliability and scale.

Requirements

  • Proficient English – Level C1–C2.
  • 2+ years managing social media for a brand, program, or agency (startup/VC/tech/creative/corporate-innovation experience a plus).
  • Proven experience building social listening workflows and maintaining databases/dashboards that track accounts, mentions, and engagement.
  • Strong copywriting and editing skills; comfortable adapting tone for platform and audience.
  • Proficiency with social and analytics tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Hootsuite, Buffer, Brandwatch, Meltwater, Talkwalker, native platform analytics, GA4, UTM tracking, Looker/Data Studio, or equivalent).
  • Spreadsheet proficiency (Google Sheets/Excel) for database upkeep and reporting; familiarity with CRM (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) a plus.
  • Excellent time management, attention to detail, and organizational skills; comfort working cross-functionally with Marketing, Partnerships, and program teams.
  • Basic visual skills (briefing design, light editing in Canva/Adobe) and familiarity with accessibility best practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or related field (preferred).
  • Entrepreneurial spirit and a self-starter.
  • Commitment to equity across race, place, and gender.
  • A "no job is beneath me" mentality.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
You will be working directly with Toptal’s clients to understand their needs, custom-match them with Developers from our talent network, and provide support during the matching process.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Work with clients to understand their needs, custom-match them with Engineering experts from different specialties within our talent network (Software Development, DevOps, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, among others), and provide support during the matching process, throughout the engagement, and beyond.
  • Manage client expectations effectively.
  • Write professional, engaging, and accurate job descriptions to attract the best talent for the job.
  • Find the right talent to meet client goals.
  • Introduce the talent to the client in a way that showcases the talent’s experience, skills, and relevance to the client’s business needs.
  • Manage the matching process end-to-end to ensure a positive experience for both the client and talent, including:
  • Confirm that talent meets both skills and experience criteria along with the commitment and timezone constraints.
  • Track, understand, and incorporate client and talent feedback to increase the likelihood of success.
  • Work collaboratively with other teams to effectively take advantage of opportunities, remove friction in the process, and deal with engagement issues when they arise.
In the first week, expect to:
  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision.
  • Familiarize yourself with the team’s tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Shadow matching calls and learn about the matching process with your TopPal.
In the first month, expect to:
  • Take on your first clients and manage their engagements with Toptal, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Learn about supporting teams and how they contribute to the company’s success.
  • Work closely with individual Developer talents from our network.
  • Become proficient with Toptal’s platform.
In the first three months, expect to:
  • Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Talent Matching, Customer Team, and other functions of Talent Operations.
  • Build a mature client portfolio.
  • Establish direct connections with top talent in our network.
In the first six months, expect to:
  • Become eligible to take on Toptal’s major accounts, including top-tier brands and clients.
  • Understand best practices and share effective strategies with the team.
In the first year, expect to:
  • Act as a subject matter expert on Development Matching.
  • Continue to promote an environment of teamwork and collaboration.
  • Offer insights and ways to improve the success of a matching lifecycle based on feedback, experience, and data insights.
  • Start taking on initiatives to improve operations and establish the needed infrastructure for scale.
  • Participate in onboarding newcomers and helping them learn about best practices.

Join to apply for the Business Services Team Manager role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthroughs across public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world\'s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration. This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues. Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 3EA7 services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing.

Responsibilities

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

title: Data Onboarding Specialist
description:
About Bonsai

Bonsai is an all-in-one platform helping agencies, consultancies, and professional service firms run and scale their operations. From lean 5-person studios to 100-person teams, thousands of businesses around the world rely on Bonsai to streamline their workflows and manage everything from proposals and contracts to tasks, time tracking, invoicing, and finances.

As the way we work evolves, so do the needs of modern service businesses. Admin and operations can quickly become a bottleneck to growth—Bonsai removes that friction, so teams can stay focused on delivering great work, not managing overhead.

We’re profitable, growing fast, and backed by world-class investors including Y Combinator, Matrix Partners, and Index Ventures.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Data Onboarding Specialist to join our team and play a key role in helping new customers set up and migrate their data into Bonsai. This role is less about advanced analytics and coding, and more about ensuring customer data is clean, structured, and seamlessly integrated (primarily using Excel and Google Sheets).

You’ll work directly with customer success, operations, and product teams to make onboarding as smooth and efficient as possible. If you love working with spreadsheets, have an eye for detail, and enjoy finding creative ways to manipulate data, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and support customer data migrations during onboarding
  • Clean, format, and transform datasets (99% in Excel/Google Sheets) to ensure accuracy and usability
  • Use formulas, macros, AI tools, and VBA scripts to streamline repetitive tasks and ensure consistency
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, errors, or gaps with precision
  • Work closely with onboarding and customer success teams to ensure a smooth handoff and strong customer experience
  • Provide creative solutions for data-related challenges, often finding ways to make complex migrations simple
  • Document and improve internal data processes to increase efficiency over time
  • Support ongoing operational data needs as Bonsai scales

What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced experience with Excel and Google Sheets
  • Strong attention to detail —accuracy and quality of data is very important for this role
  • Excellent English communication skills , both written and verbal
  • Ability to work independently, stay highly organized, and juggle multiple onboarding projects

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in SaaS onboarding or operations
  • Background at a fast-growing tech company or fintech
  • Remote-first role
  • Work closely with a global team in a fast-growing SaaS company
  • All-expenses-paid team retreats — our last retreat was in Lisbon
  • A chance to make a real impact on a product that helps small businesses succeed

A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Staff Product Designer
description:
Overview

Grupo QuintoAndar | Staff Product Designer role at QuintoAndar

About QuintoAndar

O QuintoAndar nasceu para fazer algo muito gratificante: abrir portas. Abrimos portas para que a tecnologia fizesse parte do morar. E, por meio dela, simplificamos e desburocratizamos a experiência de quem busca por um novo lar. Assim, nos tornamos a proptech mais valiosa da América Latina, liderando o mercado imobiliário em cerca de seis países e mais de 75 cidades ao redor do globo.

Após conquistar o Brasil com um modelo de negócios pioneiro no mercado de Aluguel e Compra e Vendas de imóveis, expandimos para o mercado internacional ao adquirirmos o Grupo Navent, Argentina (Zonaprop), Peru (Adondevivir & Urbania) e Equador (Plusvalia) - entre outros.

Oferecemos um ecossistema de ponta a ponta para facilitar a vida daqueles que procuram alugar ou comprar uma casa, vender um imóvel e desbloquear uma transação. Pense em zero papel ou burocracia: tudo acontece em uma única plataforma, com transparência e rapidez ao lado de um suporte humanizado e próximo.

Atualmente, estamos avaliados em mais de US$ 5,1 bilhões (agosto de 2021) e continuamos a crescer 4x ano após ano, quebrando recordes.

Para que tudo isso aconteça, contamos com mais de 4 mil pessoas talentosas, trabalhando com tecnologia de ponta e as melhores práticas de design para garantir uma experiência perfeita durante todo o processo de venda e locação, aliada também a produtos financeiros inteligentes. Aqui você vai trabalhar com os melhores profissionais do mercado, num ambiente que respira inovação, colaboração e alta performance.

Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados por um propósito compartilhado de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, contamos com um portfólio diversificado de marcas e soluções que contemplam todas as fases da jornada do morar. Desenvolvemos tecnologias e inovação para transformar e impulsionar a experiência de moradia como um todo.

Trabalhar no QuintoAndar

  • Possibilidade de aprendizado;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em um time que busca utilizar as melhores práticas e ferramentas do mercado;
  • Atuar em um ambiente informal com uma estrutura horizontal;
  • Ser parte de um time que trabalha em um projeto de alto impacto e que afeta a vida de milhares de pessoas

Localização e Trabalho Remoto

Nossos time de tecnologia trabalha no modelo remote-first, o que significa que estamos trabalhando de casa com a possibilidade de morar em qualquer lugar do Brasil.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Nossos passos costumam durar 30-40 dias, desde a inscrição até a avaliação final. Etapas:

  • Aplicação;
  • Validação de Portfolio;
  • Entrevista com nosso time de People;
  • Discussão de Case com time de Design;
  • Entrevista com Líderes de Design;
  • Entrevista com Stakeholders;
  • Offer
  • A ordem das etapas pode variar ao longo do processo seletivo

Como Staff Product Designer no QuintoAndar você irá

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e a evolução dos nossos produtos e serviços, garantindo a consistência em todas as plataformas
  • Entregar soluções para nossos usuários internos e externos, criando uma experiência única e encantadora no segmento de Living (busca de imóveis, agendar visitas, fazer proposta, se mudar, e morar em uma propriedade alugada ou comprada)
  • Colaborar com designers de produtos para garantir uma experiência única e encantadora no segmento de Housing (busca de imóveis, agendar visitas, fazer proposta, se mudar, e morar em uma propriedade alugada ou comprada)
  • Trabalhar em uma equipe multidisciplinar de engenheiros, gerente de produto e outras partes interessadas para entender as necessidades de negócios e participar da tomada de decisões
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de engenharia para uma implementação impecável de seus projetos
  • Usar, colaborar e evoluir o nosso Design System
  • Participar de discussões e contribuir para o desenvolvimento de estratégias de design de longo prazo da empresa
  • Dar e receber feedbacks sobre processos e entrega de soluções dentro de sua equipe de produto, design e engenharia

Requirements

  • Boas habilidades de prototipação, para explorar e tangibilizar múltiplas direções de design, de acordo com hipóteses baseadas no entendimento dos usuários, objetivos de negócio e possibilidades técnicas
  • Experiência no ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de produto, da definição do problema ao lançamento da solução.
  • Portfólio sólido, que demonstre experiência em desenhar e lançar produtos digitais relevantes
  • Experiência em apresentação para stakeholders seniores
  • Conhecimentos em psicologia cognitiva, metodologias de pesquisa e dados de utilização.
  • Experiência em mentorar designers sêniores e plenos

Importante

  • O nosso processo seletivo começa na inscrição! Se você está realmente a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, capriche nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno mesmo para quem não segue no processo;

Benefits

  • Salário competitivo (Contrato CLT);
  • Ticket refeição (Flash Benefícios);
  • Auxílio transporte*;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica (opcional);
  • Seguro de vida;

  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
  • Espaço para amamentação;
  • Descontos em instituições de ensino;
  • Clube de Benefícios;
  • Playkids;
  • Bicicletário gratuito no estacionamento.

Diversity and Inclusion no QuintoAndar

No QuintoAndar, acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho, baseado no respeito e na valorização das diferenças. Fique à vontade para declarar as informações do formulário de inscrição. Caso você não se sinta confortável em respondê-las é só optar por não responder. Essas informações nos ajudam a criar um ambiente cada vez mais inclusivo e são utilizadas apenas para essa finalidade, são confidenciais e não impactarão no seu desempenho no processo seletivo.

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e não encontrou nenhuma vaga de seu interesse, deixe seu currículo em nosso banco.

Política de Proteção a Dados

Os dados que você informar no formulário do processo seletivo são confidenciais e estão armazenados em ambiente seguro, nós adotamos medidas técnicas e administrativas aptas para proteger os seus dados. Para saber mais sobre como tratamos os dados pessoais acesse nossa Política de Privacidade.

Para exercer os seus direitos sobre os seus dados pessoais, como acesso aos dados, confirmação de tratamento, correção dos dados, anonimização, bloqueio ou eliminação e outros direitos com o Grupo QuintoAndar, entre em contato com a gente por Canal de Atendimento.

Homeward aims to take the “what ifs” out of homebuying by creating financial products that buyers and sellers use to get certainty and convenience in the real estate market. Homeward is looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator to join the team responsible for the design, implementation, and success of our Salesforce ecosphere. This individual will be responsible for owning support issues on a day-to-day basis, developing runbooks, and contributing to new strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who takes pride in ownership of their projects, can effectively diagnose issues, develop solutions quickly, and communicate clearly with multiple stakeholders.

  • Join our Salesforce Systems Team and have an immediate impact on the company and the implementation of our Salesforce instance
  • Work directly with our Product and Engineering Team, members of our Sales & Operations teams, as well as the organization as a whole, to improve the process of buying and selling homes
  • Prioritize and manage incoming development requests from stakeholders, and effectively oversee the ticket queue to ensure timely resolution of Salesforce issues and enhancements.
  • Collaborate on projects ranging from 3rd party integrations to development of new business processes that promote efficiency, scalability, and risk mitigation
  • Focus on bridging the gap between development and end users
  • Contribute to documentation, product scoping, and training
  • Collaborate on strategies to manage Salesforce metadata & tabular data
  • Work side-by-side with our existing Salesforce experts to own Salesforce implementation and architecture planning
  • Work closely with our engineering team to build integrations & develop processes that scale our operations & sales efforts
  • Wear both light development and administration hats - as a growing organization, we’ll need an administrator who can fill both roles to ensure we plan data structures and configurations for scaling

  • 3+ years of Salesforce administration experience, ideally in a growth business
  • Credentials
    • Required: Salesforce Certified Administrator & Advanced Administrator

  • Incredibly strong ownership of delivering the right solutions at a high quality
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Value-Driven Employee Experience
THE GOLDEN RULE . It’s simple: Treat others the way we want to be treated. Whether we’re dealing with colleagues or customers, we don’t prioritize money or growth over people, and we practice empathy at every opportunity.

ONE TEAM, ONE DREAM . Big problems require big solutions. We look at our customers’ experiences holistically and recognize that solving them requires collaboration across teams and our three affiliate companies — Homeward, Homeward Mortgage and Homeward Title.

Cumprir todas as expectativas comportamentais da Declaração de Compromisso com a Proteção Infantil e do Código de Conduta da Compassion. Relatar quaisquer preocupações de abuso, negligência ou exploração de crianças por meio do processo interno de denúncias da Compassion e apoiar adequadamente as respostas a incidentes, caso ocorram.
  • Contribui para o trabalho dos facilitadores de parceria e da equipe e gerentes multifuncionais dentro de uma área de especialidade designada. Apoia o aprendizado e o aprimoramento da comunidade de desenvolvimento infantil entre a equipe e outras partes interessadas. Auxilia os líderes da comunidade a promover a transformação local. Também pode contribuir para iniciativas especiais.
  • Conforme orientado, ajuda a entregar a programação dentro da área de saúde. Consolida os dados locais para identificar lacunas e padrões comuns. Mantém e apoia a implementação da estratégia de saúde da família.

  • Fornece informações à administração e outros tomadores de decisão sobre a alocação de recursos adequados.

Trabalha com facilitadores de parcerias, garantindo que os registros de intervenção, relatórios e outras documentações sejam precisos, completos e entregues às partes interessadas apropriadas.
  • Ajuda a preparar dados, relatórios e conclusões para apoiar a administração e as principais partes interessadas na melhoria das iniciativas do programa, intervenções e resultados infantis.
  • Ajuda a manter o Programa de Sobrevivência Infantil e pode monitorar os orçamentos dele, conforme designado. Ajuda a fornecer apoio curricular e materiais de treinamento às mães com base em programas estabelecidos. title: Security Risk Management Specialist
description:
Overview

In security risk management we're looking to harness the power of industry best practice combined with driving new innovation on how we do security risk assessments and modelling. Our security risk management team is the primary owner of the strategy and practices of how we identify, track and reduce our security risk across everything we do. To support this we need to use industry best practices paired with emerging threat information to promote risk identification, quantification, impact analysis, and modelling to ultimately drive decision making. In this role, you will help establish and execute a broad strategic vision for the security risk program at Canonical. You will work within the team and cross-functionally with various teams across the organisation, contributing ideas and requirements for Canonical product security to improve resilience for Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attacks. The team also collaborates with our Organisational Learning and Development team to develop playbooks and facilitate security training across Canonical.

The security risk management team\'s mission is to secure Canonical and contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They may share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

Responsibilities

  • Define Canonical\'s security risk management standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical\'s security risk practices
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security requirements, tools and practices
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical security risk management practice
  • Develop Canonical security risk learning and development materials
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
  • Participate in developing key risk indicators, and provide inputs to the development of key control indicators and key performance indicators for various programs
  • Apply statistical models to risk frameworks (such as FAIR, sensitivity analysis, and others)
  • Participate in risk management, decision-making, and collaborative discussions
  • Lead quantified risk assessments and understand the value of qualitative data for improvements to quality and engineering processes
  • Interpret internal or external cyber security risk analyses in business terms and recommend a responsible course of action
  • Develop templates and materials to help with self-service risk management actions
  • Monitor and identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of risk management processes
  • Launch campaigns to perform security assessments and help mitigate security risks across the company
  • Build evaluation methods and performance indicators to measure the efficiency of security functions and capabilities

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Leadership and management ability
  • Excellent business English writing and presentation skills
  • Problem-solver with excellent communication skills, a deep technical understanding of security assessments and risk management
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Broad knowledge of how to operationalize the management of security risk
  • Experience in Secure Development Lifecycle and Security by Design methodology

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist, Staffing
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist, Staffing – remote position at Toptal

We are seeking a versatile and adaptable Talent Specialist to join our Staffing team. This role combines both sourcing and recruiting responsibilities: you will own the full candidate lifecycle — from proactive sourcing and outreach, coordinating interviews, and guiding candidates through the hiring process. The focus is on staffing solutions for engineering and technical roles (direct hire, contract-to-hire, and temporary placements) across industry sectors. You’ll partner closely with hiring managers, client account leads, and other internal teams to ensure we build strong, scalable candidate pipelines while delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies to identify top talent across relevant industries and regions.
  • Build and maintain strong pipelines for key staffing roles (e.g., engineers, technicians).
  • Proactively source, identify, and engage candidates using multiple channels.
  • Conduct candidate outreach, screening calls, and in-depth interviews to assess fit for direct hire, contract-to-hire, and temporary roles.
  • Manage the full recruiting process: scheduling interviews, collecting feedback, extending offers, and supporting onboarding.
  • Partner with internal account managers and client stakeholders to align on requirements, timelines, and hiring expectations.
  • Track progress against KPIs (time-to-fill, pipeline health, quality of hire) and provide data-driven updates to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with staffing requirements, including documentation, background checks, and employment eligibility.
  • Use ATS and sourcing tools to manage pipelines, keep data accurate, and maintain clear candidate records.
  • Contribute to process improvements, playbooks, and sourcing best practices to support scalability as the staffing business grows.

First Weeks & Months

  • In the first week : Onboard and integrate into Toptal; undergo role-specific training.
  • In the first month : Begin sourcing candidates for open staffing requisitions and build role-specific pipelines; partner with hiring managers and account leads to align on staffing needs.
  • In the first three months : Own the full recruiting lifecycle for assigned staffing roles; place your first candidates into direct hire or contract-to-hire roles; establish strong working relationships with hiring managers and account leads.
  • In the first six months : Consistently meet time-to-fill targets and deliver high-quality candidates; refine sourcing strategies and proactively anticipate client staffing needs; be seen as a trusted recruiting partner across the staffing team.
  • In the first year : Fully own and be recognized as the subject matter expert for staffing recruitment; contribute to strategic initiatives that improve staffing operations, processes, and candidate experience.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 3–4+ years of recruiting and/or sourcing experience, ideally within staffing or agency environments.
  • Proven success filling direct hire, contract-to-hire, and temp roles.
  • Proficiency in LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing platforms.
  • Strong interviewing, candidate assessment, and pipeline management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom, etc.).
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company while managing multiple requisitions.
  • Remote work experience preferred.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform)
description:
Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform)

Join to apply for the Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform) role at FirstIgnite

Base pay range
$50,000.00/yr - $75,000.00/yr

About Us FirstIgnite is at the forefront of innovation, building a cutting-edge SaaS platform that bridges the gap between academia and industry through smart technology and AI-driven tools. Our platform empowers tech transfer offices, researchers, and decision-makers with actionable insights to commercialize high-potential inventions. As we expand and scale quickly, we’re looking for a dynamic, creative, and fast-moving Product Designer to join our growing team, shape the user experience, and evolve our product to meet the needs of our diverse user base. We prize simplicity, innovation, and collaboration, and if that excites you—we’d love to have you onboard.

The Role We are searching for an exceptional Product Designer to take ownership of the end-to-end design process for our SaaS platform. As our Product Designer, you’ll be juggling between ideation, prototyping, and refinement to bring elegant and intuitive experiences to life. In an environment where speed meets thoughtfulness, you’ll have the chance to move quickly while making meaningful contributions to key product decisions. This role isn’t just about pushing pixels—it’s about working closely with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to ensure that every decision improves the user experience, feels effortless, and aligns with the overall product vision as we continue building features at a blistering pace.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Design: Own the entire design cycle—from brainstorming and research to delivering high-fidelity mockups, wireframes, prototypes, and additional specifications for engineering teams.
  • Collaborate Thoughtfully: Work with product managers, engineers, and leadership to collect feedback, iterate quickly, and guide conversations about feature direction and experience.
  • Design Intuitive and Modern Interfaces: Deliver sleek, functional, and visually stunning designs that elevate the user’s experience.
  • Fluent in English: Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential for collaborating with the team and stakeholders.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Translate ideas into fast and effective mockups for approval before extensive backend resources are allocated for development.
  • Platform Usability Improvements: Audit user workflows across the SaaS platform and recommend changes to improve core usability.
  • Front-End Familiarity: Have a basic working knowledge of front-end frameworks (Vue.js, Sass/SCSS, Bulma/Buefy) to create feasible designs while collaborating with developers on what's possible. Bonus if you can help refine and implement your own designs in the code!
  • Stay Agile: Work at speed to meet evolving project deadlines while maintaining high-quality designs that meet business objectives.
  • Push the Boundaries: Explore modern design technologies and solutions to keep our platform fresh and competitive.
  • Develop Design Systems: Evolve and maintain a scalable design system with reusable components for consistent styling across the tool.

Who You Are We’re looking for a Product Designer with a mix of creativity, technical fluency, and execution speed. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be obsessed with how great products feel and function, and have the strategic mind to assess what’s worth investing in and when.

Here’s Your Checklist

  • Proven Experience: 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Designer (or similar roles in SaaS/Product-focused environments with web platforms).
  • Design Portfolio: A rich set of sample designs showing intuitive interface designs, thoughtful workflows, design systems, prototypes, and processes that brought measurable success to a product.
  • Rapid Prototyping Skills: Ability to create both low-fidelity wireframes and pixel-perfect high-fidelity designs with a focus on speed and flexibility.
  • Modern Design Tools: Proficiency with Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Framer, or other preferred tools.
  • User-First Thinker: Deep understanding of user pain points, workflows, and human-centered design principles.
  • Familiarity with Front-End Frameworks: Working knowledge of Vue.js, SCSS, Bulma/Buefy or equivalent front-end principles to align design and development.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Quick to bounce ideas off team members and justify design decisions to non-design stakeholders.
  • Technical Exposure (Preferred): Basic coding skills (HTML/CSS/Vue.js) to bring designs to life on the platform.
  • Innovation-Seeker: Stay up to date on UX trends and SaaS practices to recommend emerging ideas.
  • Team Player with Ownership: Independent yet collaborative to build the best product together.
  • Detail-Oriented but Fast: Manage priorities and meet deadlines with accuracy and minimal back-and-forth.

Our Tech Stack We’re flexible. Our current stack includes Vue.js, Sass/SCSS, and Bulma/Buefy, and we value your framework familiarity and recommendations for empowering you. Collaboration with Engineering will be vital to finalizing deliverables.

Why You’ll Love Working at FirstIgnite

  • Speed and Innovation: We’re moving quickly and evolving constantly, so you’ll work on fresh, impactful challenges.
  • Collaborative Team: Respect, trust, open communication, and solution-minded teammates.
  • Impactful Work: Your designs will directly impact user experience and product decisions.
  • Opportunity to push modern boundaries in SaaS design and scaling design systems for rapid growth.
  • Design boldly, fail fast, and learn using the latest tools and trends.

What Success Looks Like

  • Designs are implemented with minimal back-and-forth due to clear communication and engineering alignment.
  • Efficient delivery of multiple feature mockups each week aligned with product timelines.
  • Clear, intuitive workflows guiding users toward goals with a strong user experience.
  • A platform design that feels modern, fast, and trustworthy within the SaaS market.

How To Apply

Please include the following: portfolio, resume, and a brief cover letter explaining why you’re excited about FirstIgnite and how your skills will elevate the product.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FirstIgnite by 2x. Get notified about new Product Designer jobs in Brazil.

description:
Our leading SaaS-based Global Growth Platform enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

We are seeking an Employment Counsel - LATAM to join our dynamic legal team. As Employment Counsel - LATAM, you will help G-P navigate the complexities of employment law and compliance across LATAM, providing strategic legal advice and guidance on all aspects of employment law across LATAM. This role will partner closely with our People, Global Operations, Product teams, and business leaders to ensure compliance with local employment laws, mitigate legal risks, manage and resolve disputes and litigation, and support the company’s strategic objectives. The successful candidate will be a motivated, solutions-oriented attorney with experience across a wide range of employment matters, who is capable of navigating complex legal challenges and providing practical, business-focused advice in a fast-paced, global environment. This role will report to Senior Employment Counsel, Manager - LATAM.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Provide high quality legal advice on a broad range of employment law matters throughout the LATAM region, including but not limited to hiring practices, employee relations, accommodations, disciplinary processes, terminations, workplace investigations, and employment compliance.
  2. Develop and provide innovative, practical business-driven solutions to manage employment-related legal risks.
  3. Collaborate with HR and Operations teams and other stakeholders to develop and implement employment practices, HR policies, and procedures that comply with local and international laws.
  4. Manage employment-related disputes, claims, and litigation across LATAM, including managing and liaising with outside local counsel and business units as necessary.
  5. Monitor and interpret new and changing employment laws and regulations and partner with HR, Operations and other stakeholders to develop compliance strategies.
  6. Draft, review, and update employment-related agreements, documents, policies, and procedures.
  7. Participate in the creation and delivery of training related to employment law matters.
  8. Partner with the Product teams to ensure compliance with employment laws across G-P’s products and platforms.
  9. Assorted other legal team projects to address the needs of a global, high-growth company.

Qualifications:

  1. Qualified lawyer in Brazil, Colombia or another jurisdiction in the LATAM region.
  2. 5-8 years of employment law experience in a law firm and/or in-house legal department. Experience working at a multinational company across various jurisdictions is a plus.
  3. Experience on a broad range of employment law matters, including hiring, employee relations, investigations, terminations, HR policies, employment compliance, and litigation. Experience managing health and safety or occupational risk matters, as well as accommodations, is a plus.
  4. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to provide practical legal advice and creative solutions to complex legal matters, ensuring alignment with evolving business needs.
  5. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  6. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English with the ability to convey complex legal concepts clearly and concisely.
  7. Ability to work collaboratively and engage with diverse stakeholders across the organization in an international setting.

description:
